newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian agency arrests ITC deputy chairman.
newsitem.headline: Indian agency arrests ITC deputy chairman.

text.p: India's Enforcement Directorate has arrested the deputy chairman of ITC Ltd Saurabh Misra and a senior executive of the company for alleged foreign exchange violations, enforcement officials said on Friday.

"We have arrested the two on charges of serious Foreign Exchange Regulation Act (FERA) violation," K.K. Kabirpanthi, deputy director of the eastern regional office of the Enforcement Directorate, told reporters.
The directorate arrested Misra and R. Ranganathan, chief executive officer of ITC's tobacco division, early on Friday, he said.
Kabirpanthi said Misra and Ranganathan would be produced before a metropolitan magistrate on Friday.
"It could be a frame-up," Saurabh Misra told reporters, when asked about his arrest.
Two former chairmen of ITC Ltd, K.L. Chugh and J.N. Sapru, were arrested last week and remanded in judicial custody until November 13 by a local court.
